_about: Draft capture values moved out of PLAN.md in revision 0.14. Quotas carry the clip design effect x1.6, an assumed prior until measured from the pilot 30 clips (intra-clip correlation, re-sized as for recall); test 40 pins the golden 392 x 1.6 -> 628.

designEffect.method: intra-clip correlation from the pilot 30 clips
designEffect.reMeasure: 0.16: after the pilot 30 clips, compute the intra-clip correlation and re-size every quota; test 40 prints 'assumed' beside each quota until status reads 'measured'

firstWeek.classes: the Drone list; tree seeded from tree, vehicle from custom01
firstWeek.conditions: thin wires at range (wire height recorded), sky glare, motion blur
firstWeek.day1: the labeler has 10 wire clips at range in R2; the integrator starts the obstacle layer and synthetic frames

usedBy.blindFouledClips: drone-avoid-01 frame-health floors and the blind or fouled Gate 2 stratum

firstWeek.usedByNote: unmappedWire 628 feeds an advisory and the Gate 2 wire stratum only: the rangefinder is the covering sensor, and the camera is refused for unmapped wire at every tier
firstWeek.storageEstimate: 588 clips x 20 s x 20 fps x 60 KB = about 14 GB (assumed 20 s clips, 60 KB per stored frame, 49 clips per class per set; checked against the members-only project store)

firstWeek.conditions: turbidity, glare, spray; medium and current speed recorded per clip; drift-distance truth (GNSS track while thrust is cut, 0.19) on every current clip, binned by standOffFraction
firstWeek.day1: the labeler has 10 hull or pier clips in glare; the remote operator runs the takeover drill in simulation; the integrator starts the water step

medium.note: surfaced-only first loop; R2 refuses a water clip whose medium is not water-surface (underwater clips wait for the underwater row)

usedBy.blindFouledClips: manta-hold-01 frame-health floors and the blind or fouled Gate 2 stratum

firstWeek.storageEstimate: 490 clips x 20 s x 4 fps x 60 KB = about 2.4 GB (assumed 20 s clips, 60 KB per stored frame, 49 clips per class per set; checked against the members-only project store)

firstWeek.classes: spill, smoke or fire, blocked exit, door open after hours
firstWeek.conditions: indoor light, night corridor; consented pictures only
firstWeek.day1: the camera integrator commits the values and the consent check; capture waits for consent
firstWeek.storageEstimate: per hazard, sized when the camera values are signed (assumed 20 s clips, 60 KB per stored frame, 49 clips per class per set; checked against the members-only project store)

firstWeek.classes: the MASS-AI and eXeL AI robot lists
firstWeek.conditions: night (visible + IR, or thermal seeded from thermal01), dust or mud; child height only with consent
firstWeek.day1: the labeler has 10 night step clips; the integrator starts the ground step and dock marker

usedBy.heldOutPerClass: mass-nav-01 and exel-nav-01 Gate 1 per class
usedBy.step: mass-nav-01 and exel-nav-01 stop (cliff sensor covers)

firstWeek.storageEstimate: 588 clips x 20 s x 8 fps x 60 KB = about 5.6 GB (assumed 20 s clips, 60 KB per stored frame, 49 clips per class per set; checked against the members-only project store)

pixelExtent.formula: extent_px = known size (m) x focal (px at the model input size) / minimum detection range (m); focal 457 px at 640, 228.5 px at 320 (70 deg)
pixelExtent.floor: each row states minBoxPx (proposed: wire and bird 2 px wide, every other class 8 px box width); a capture passes only at minBoxPx x 1.1 or more

rows.note: refused at every tier: covering sensor required (rangefinder)
refused at every tier without a wing speed cap
a 320 px card cannot carry Drone person: 640 tier or a covering sensor
a 320 px card cannot carry swimmer: 640 tier or the hull sonar/proximity sensor

rows.result640: refused until p5 size truth or a covering sensor (forward rangefinder)
rows.note: nominal 0.3 m gives margin 1.034, under 1.10 with no field-of-view or range tolerance; refused until R2 measures a p5 or the forward rangefinder is named as its covering sensor (round 18)

rows.result640: refused until p5 size truth or a covering sensor (forward rangefinder)
rows.note: nominal 0.3 m gives margin 1.034, under 1.10 with no field-of-view or range tolerance; refused until R2 measures a p5 or the forward rangefinder is named as its covering sensor (round 18)
quad bird keyed by its own loop row (round 17)
refused at every tier: the forward rangefinder or stand-off geofence covers a child, never the camera alone
child row for a place that may see minors
child row for a place that may see minors
refused at every size: the hull sonar or proximity sensor covers a child swimmer, never the camera alone

pixelExtent.test: test 40 recomputes every px value and result from the parameter files and refuses a row with no minBoxPx or no result per tier; R2 refuses a capture under its class floor for the loop tier named on the card; 0.16: test 40 refuses any class in a loops.rows Classes cell with no pixel row
pixelExtent._changed: 0.15: minBoxPx and a result per tier on every row
pixelExtent.key: (class, loop row): one row per class per loops.rows entry and per speedEnvelope row that flies it; test 40 refuses a missing or duplicate pair
pixelExtent.sizeRule: knownSizeM is the class's small end (p5 of R2 size truth per class), not a nominal; until measured the nominal is marked 'provisional'; test 40 recomputes it
pixelExtent.marginRule: margin640 = px640 / (minBoxPx x 1.1); test 40 refuses a pass under 1.10 unless the row states the field-of-view and range tolerance it was computed at
pixelExtent.childRule: every loop whose place may see minors (Drone, MASS-AI, eXeL robot) has a child-width (0.3 m) person row; test 40 refuses a person floor scored only on adult-width rows
pixelExtent._changed17: 0.17: keyed by class and loop row; quad bird and child-width rows; margin column; small-end size rule
pixelExtent._changed18: 0.18: sizeTruth per row ('nominal' or 'p5 measured, n'); test 40 refuses 'nominal' on a class a loop-ready card claims; margins kept to 3 decimals (bird wing 0.995, never 1.0); pole and tree refused until p5 or a covering sensor; Manta child-swimmer row; rows to be keyed by inputW x inputH from the card file entry (focal from width at the declared field of view), never px640/px320 columns, at C1; test 40 refuses a 'pass' under margin 1.10 with no fovToleranceDeg and rangeTolerancePct

firstWeekUsedByRule: 0.16: usedBy is per quota key, a loop id plus an output kind (action, alert, advisory, report); test 40 refuses a quota whose usedBy is not a loops.rows purpose

replayRule.rule: replay and held-out clips are stored whole at no less than the loop's replayFps (Drone 20, MASS-AI and eXeL robot 8, Manta 4); only training picks are decimated to 4 frames/s; every frame of a full-rate clip with a person, swimmer or child-height frame is blurred, and one unblurred frame refuses the whole clip
replayRule.goldens: R2 test: a 10 fps clip is refused for the air replay set; one unblurred frame in a 20 fps clip refuses the clip

codec.rule: name the clip storage codec (lossless or a fixed-decoder codec), bytes per frame and decoder version; storageEstimate uses those bytes; R2 golden: the same clip decoded by the browser and Python runners gives identical frame hashes

vehicle.from: custom01 (models.json:145, the 91-label COCO map, same as demo90)

seedClassMap.test: test 40 refuses a seeded class whose source labels are missing from that model's labels array; each contributor's class page shows the same map (vehicle <- car, bus, truck, motorcycle)
